messages:
maya: Quick proposal — can we shorten tomorrow's ops-sync to 25m and switch RFC/design reviews to an "as-needed" follow-up slot? Meeting's been drifting and a shorter focused cadence might help.

maya: Proposed 25m agenda: 1) 7m bug queue + hotfixes, 2) 8m owner updates (blocked/unblocked), 3) 5m lightning items (PR pings, deploy notes), 4) 5m action items + owner handoff.

jonathan: +1 to shorter. the RFC reviews always balloon. can we carve a standing 30m weekly "design review" for folks who want to do deep dives?

samir: I like that. suggestion: keep a rotating "coverage owner" to triage bug queue in advance so we don't spend first 10m scanning. owner posts a 1-line digest in thread before the call.

nina: can we add a single health metric to the top? e.g., blocked PRs count and high-priority bug count. 1 line, max. helps decision-making. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maya: good call. updated agenda with metric: 0) 30s health snapshot (blocked PRs / critical bugs) then rest as above.

oliver: i can take coverage owner this week. i'll drop the digest by noon tomorrow.

jonathan: for the design reviews, +1 to a separate invite. let's use a tag "eng-design" so people opt in.

samir: minor ops note — please keep the lightning items to <= 2 and link PRs in the thread. keeps post-meeting follow-ups tidy.

nina: if we're shortening, can we also move the recurring calendar to an earlier slot? afternoons are getting noisy. earlier = better for EU folks. :sunrise_over_mountains:

maya: propose moving to 09:30 PT. agree/disagree?

jonathan: 09:30 PT works for me.

oliver: ok from my side.

samir: works.

calendar-bot: Updated event "ENG Ops Sync" to 09:30 PT, duration 25m. Added description with new agenda and link to design-review invite.

maya: awesome — thanks all. i'll update the invite description with the rotating owner table and the "post digest by noon" rule.

jonathan: tiny ask — can the owner table be a single line per week like: `2026-06-10: oliver (bugs), 2026-06-17: samir` so calendar description stays compact?

maya: yep, will do. i'll post the initial table and the digest template in #eng this afternoon.

oliver: thanks — i'll prep tomorrow's digest (blocked PRs: 2, critical bugs: 1, quick notes: DB migration queued).

samir: :thumbsup:

maya: closing loop — agenda changes live, calendar updated, oliver owns this week's digest. see you tomorrow, 09:30 PT.

maya: (if anyone can't make it, please ping and leave your update in thread; we'll read it aloud if present)
